input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including jwt user, jwt user details, jwt authentication token. The platform provides capabilities for jwt success handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage jwt user records, so that I can track and organize jwt user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage jwt user details records, so that I can track and organize jwt user details data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage jwt authentication token records, so that I can track and organize jwt authentication token data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to interact with hello functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello-related tasks.
